marketDirection.headline: Indian market is advancing today.

reasons.text: Nifty 50 closed -1.75% at 25,350, above its 20-DMA, above the 50-DMA (rising), above the 200-DMA.
The index is up 0.2% over the last five sessions — uptrend structure intact.
Market breadth is cautious — 26.4% of scanned NSE stocks advancing, 39.5% above their 50-DMA.
Strong broad-market breath expansion from swing support provides high odds for multi-week base breakout attempts across large-cap leaders.
Clearing key execution bottlenecks directly addresses market concerns on delivery cadence, setting up support for an impending range breakout attempt.

marketDirection.disclaimer: A rules-based read of index price, market breadth and headline flow — not a forecast or trading advice.

marketSummary: Indian equity benchmarks recorded a decisive upside expansion on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, with the Nifty 50 rallying 469.60 points (+1.85%) to settle at 25,819.25 and the Sensex leaping 1,502.29 points (+1.82%) to close at 83,938.28. The powerful rebound was fueled by massive FII net equity inflows crossing record monthly thresholds (including ₹5,673 crore in a single previous session), easing Brent crude to $90.10 per barrel, and the Indian Rupee advancing 69 paise to 92.16. Large-cap heavyweights across private banking, FMCG, and consumer discretionary pushed price structures out of recent short-term pullbacks back toward multi-week base resistance levels.
dailyFocus: Track swing continuation in consumption and private banks as the Nifty reclaims the 25,800 hurdle, while monitoring right-side consolidation patterns in defence and capital goods leaders ahead of scheduled institutional roadshows and large order execution milestones.

sectors.name: FMCG & Consumption
sectors.reason: The FMCG index gained 3.14% to touch three-month highs, spearheaded by heavy institutional buying in HUL (+5.94%) and retail pace-setter Trent (+3.59%), benefiting directly from cooling input commodity costs and domestic demand resilient print.
catalysts: Cooling raw material input costs from softer international crude and edible oils
Sustained institutional rotation into stable cash-flow consumer franchises
risks: Paring of defensive positions if high-beta cyclicals continue outperforming
Rural demand unevenness across non-metro regions

sectors.name: Banking & Financial Services
sectors.reason: Top private banking names provided over 60% of benchmark index points, propelled by persistent FII buying and easing yield pressures as the Indian Rupee staged its strongest single-day advance of the year.
catalysts: Resumed foreign institutional portfolio inflows into index heavyweights
Currency appreciation mitigating foreign exchange volatility
risks: Net interest margin compression across retail credit portfolios
Muted credit growth print in unsecured lending

sectors.name: Information Technology
sectors.reason: Nifty IT gained up to 2.6% intraday before settling in constructive recovery territory (+5.2% over three sessions), as valuation divergence between Indian IT vendors and expensive global AI hardware triggered selective value buying in TCS and Infosys.
catalysts: Valuation discount relative to global tech peers prompting institutional reallocation
Favourable cross-currency tailwinds from recent dollar-rupee stabilization
risks: Cautious discretionary corporate tech spending in western client markets

sectors.name: Capital Goods & Power Equipment
sectors.reason: Industrial heavyweights are displaying multi-week base accumulation driven by large railway infrastructure safety tenders (Kavach 4.0), data center power electrification orders, and transmission expansion.
catalysts: Rapid rollout of Kavach 4.0 train protection system across Indian Railways
Accelerating hyperscale data centre power infrastructure investment
risks: Execution and vendor supply-chain timelines stretching project cycles

sectors.name: Defence & Aerospace
sectors.reason: PSU defence majors remain structurally sound with multi-year order books, but are undergoing volume-drying base consolidation following post-earnings adjustments and intermediate profit taking.
catalysts: Clear delivery timeline commitments for Tejas Mk-1A fighter fleet by March 2027
Sustained MoD domestic procurement contract signings

news.headline: Nifty Surges 470 Points to Reclaim 25,800 on Heavy FII Inflows and Soft Crude
news.summary: NSE Nifty 50 surged 469.60 points (1.85%) to 25,819.25 while the Sensex rose 1,502 points, driven by over ₹5,672 crore in recent single-session FII net purchases, easing Brent crude near $90/barrel, and a 69-paise surge in the Indian Rupee to 92.16.
news.impact: Strong broad-market breath expansion from swing support provides high odds for multi-week base breakout attempts across large-cap leaders.

news.headline: HAL Commits to First Tejas Mk-1A Squadron Delivery by March 2027 Following Air HQ Review
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has formally committed to deliver 16 to 18 Tejas Mk-1A fighter aircraft to the Indian Air Force by March 31, 2027, after resolving critical hardware and radar integration bottlenecks following a high-level review with the IAF Chief.
news.impact: Clearing key execution bottlenecks directly addresses market concerns on delivery cadence, setting up support for an impending range breakout attempt.

news.headline: Tata Steel Moves to Acquire Controlling Stake in APL Apollo via Block Deal and Open Offer
news.summary: Tata Steel executed a binding agreement to acquire a 26.38% controlling stake from promoter entity S Gupta Holding for ₹15,510 crore at ₹2,100 per share, triggering an exchange block deal of 2.77 crore shares (9.91%) and an open offer at ₹2,301.40 per share managed by Kotak Mahindra Capital.
news.impact: Transformational deal and mandatory open offer price floor set up a high-volume accumulation pivot after deep corrective shakeout.

news.headline: L&T Subsidiary Wins ₹2,500-₹5,000 Crore Data Centre GPU Deployment Order
news.summary: Larsen & Toubro subsidiary LTN Compute secured a major contract valued between ₹2,500 crore and ₹5,000 crore to deploy additional NVIDIA B300 GPUs at its Chennai data centre campus, expanding the group's digital infrastructure pipeline.
news.impact: High-margin digital infrastructure order strengthens institutional accumulation within L&T's multi-week cup-shaped base pattern.

news.headline: Trent Outperforms Nifty with 3.6% Surge Ahead of Scheduled Institutional Roadshows
news.summary: Trent climbed 3.59% to ₹3,256 as one of Nifty's top gainers on November 25, supported by formal exchange disclosures scheduling five institutional investor meetings between November 26 and December 9, 2026, with major institutions including Capital Group and HSBC.
news.impact: Price is retesting the upper boundary of its short-term consolidation base with upcoming institutional interaction likely providing multi-day liquidity support.

news.headline: CG Power Secures ₹433 Crore Kavach 4.0 Contract from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions bagged a confirmed work order valued at ₹433 crore from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW) for supplying and integrating the advanced Kavach 4.0 train collision avoidance system on locomotives.
news.impact: Expanding footprint in mission-critical rail safety electronics offers strong volume conviction to push price past intermediate resistance pivots.

news.headline: Nifty IT Gains up to 2.6% Intraday as Foreign Capital Reassesses Tier-1 Valuations
news.summary: Nifty IT rallied to an intraday high of 32,682 on November 25, extending a three-day advance of over 5%, as institutional buyers accumulated Infosys and TCS amidst a global tech recalibration away from hyper-extended AI hardware.
news.impact: Broad-based strength across IT bellwethers builds right-side structure across large-cap tech charts testing 50-day moving average supply lines.

news.headline: Dalmia Bharat Board Approves ₹700 Crore Share Buyback at ₹1,850 per Share
news.summary: Dalmia Bharat's board approved a share buyback program aggregating up to ₹700 crore via tender offer at a price of up to ₹1,850 per share, covering up to 37.83 lakh equity shares or 2.02% of total paid-up equity.
news.impact: The premium tender offer sets an explicit technical benchmark, prompting short-covering and narrowing price contraction inside its current consolidation base.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Marks Tug Keel-Laying and Enters Clean-Vessel Agreement with Damen
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard laid the keel for the first of two ASTDS 70T tugs for Polestar Maritime and partnered with Damen Shipyards on low-emission vessel technology, augmenting momentum from its ₹498.58 crore INS Betwa MoD refit contract.
news.impact: Steady conversion of commercial and naval order backlogs helps firm up a constructive multi-week floor near key long-term exponential moving averages.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Reaffirms 15-20% FY27 Growth Target Backed by ₹2,200 Cr R&D Push
news.summary: Bharat Electronics confirmed its FY27 outlook with 15% to 20% annual revenue growth and ~28% EBITDA margins, retaining targets despite a 26% top-line jump in H1, following cumulative fresh order inflows of ₹1,528 crore booked across November.
news.impact: Predictable earnings visibility and strong margin defence keep the stock consolidating quietly in a tight volatility-contraction pattern.

news.headline: Piramal Pharma Witnesses ₹51.4 Crore Block Trade on the NSE
news.summary: Piramal Pharma saw an exchange block transaction valued at ₹51.4 crore on November 25, where approximately 22,75,390 shares were traded at an average price of ₹225.80 apiece.
news.impact: Clean transfer of large equity volume at identifiable horizontal levels highlights strong institutional price absorption within its range.
